description: Accessiboss sites and domain verification. action list (default), add (domain; confirm), plans (site optional; every plan with its limits, price with VAT per month and per year, and a checkout link per plan and billing cycle: a plan change is paid in checkout, nothing is changed by this call; a paid plan that lapses falls back to Free and the panel keeps working), verify_info (site; the four ways to prove you own the domain: OMA hosting, the script tag, a DNS TXT record, a meta tag; plus optional ready text in fi, sv and en for the site's own privacy notice), verify (site + method hosting/tag/dns/meta; confirm), delete (site; removes its settings, versions, scans and issues; confirm).

action.description: list is default. plans lists the plans with prices and a checkout link per plan and billing cycle (pass site for that site). add, verify and delete need confirm.

method.description: verify: how to prove you own the domain.

site.description: Accessiboss site: id, public key or domain. Optional when the account has one site.
